title: A1 async scope stats — demand-driven statsMode + 2-SSBO fence ring with the at-risk pack publish

commit.merge_subject: merge: A1 async scope stats — demand-driven statsMode + 2-SSBO fence ring with the at-risk pack publish

description:
A1 async stats follow-up (owner request 2026-11-23, guide A1(b)). The
original ring gave each pack exactly ONE non-blocking publish chance and
deleted the fence of any pack that missed it — on a GPU busy enough that
no fence signals within one frame, that meant every pack missed: the
scopes froze at the last sync frame while playback ran on. planAsyncFrame
now promotes the DRAW slot's own pending pack (the frame-N-2 pack the
store pass is about to overwrite) to a BOUNDED wait (50 ms, ~3 frames at
60fps) before the draw, and the normal frame-N-1 publish stays a
try-only probe (timeout 0). dropStaleFence is retired: no fence is ever
deleted over an unread SSBO, so packs are never lost and fences never
leak. The spin-starvation fix only ever waits on work that has already
had one full frame to complete.

Verified: bash tools/build-desktop.sh 21/21 suites (test_stats_ring now
